servicePage.title: Service page parts
servicePage.intro: Who it suits, what you get, the stages in order, and «اطلب هذه الخدمة» in a panel beside them.
servicePage.audience: A board that wants written rules, a ministry redistributing authority, or a family business a new generation is joining.
servicePage.deliverables:
A governance charter in language everyone understands
An authority matrix: who decides, who is consulted, who is informed
Two training sessions for the board and the executive team
servicePage.stages:
I listen: Interviews with the board, managers and staff.
I read: The current bylaws, and what actually happens.
We write together: A first draft in two workshops.
We test: Three months on real decisions.
We adopt: A final version, and training.
servicePage.oneLine: Agreed case by case, after the first conversation.
